title: What I like and what I want
description: Say what you like, want, have, eat and drink: the accusative case.

blocks.text: After verbs such as mieć (to have), lubić (to like), chcieć (to want), pić (to drink) and jeść (to eat), the object is in the accusative case. Feminine nouns ending in -a change the ending to -ę: kawa becomes kawę, herbata becomes herbatę. Neuter nouns and masculine things do not change: mleko, sok. Masculine people and animals add -a: brat becomes brata, kot becomes kota, and pies becomes psa.

lines.speaker: Ania
lines.translation: What do you like to drink in the morning?

lines.speaker: Bartek
lines.text: Lubię kawę z mlekiem. A ty?
lines.translation: I like coffee with milk. And you?
